That let me delete [sorting/IntArraySortSupport.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/035_insertion_sort/sorting/IntArraySortSupport.java:1).

This is a net simplification: the package still has the same API and behavior, but one internal layer is gone and the contract is more cohesive.
